SELECT
t3.name AS name, t4.name AS meta
DATE_FORMAT(t1.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS name, CASE DAYOFWEEK(t1.order_date) WHEN 1 THEN '일요일' WHEN 2 THEN '월요일' WHEN 3 THEN '화요일' WHEN 4 THEN '수요일' WHEN 5 THEN '목요일' WHEN 6 THEN '금요일' WHEN 7 THEN '토요일' END AS meta
CASE DAYOFWEEK(t1.order_date) WHEN 1 THEN '일요일' WHEN 2 THEN '월요일' WHEN 3 THEN '화요일' WHEN 4 THEN '수요일' WHEN 5 THEN '목요일' WHEN 6 THEN '금요일' WHEN 7 THEN '토요일' END AS name, '' AS meta
CONCAT(HOUR(t1.created_at), '시') AS name, '' AS meta
,
SUM(t2.line_total_amount) AS value
SUM(t2.qty) AS value
FROM orders t1 JOIN order_menu t2 ON t1.order_id = t2.order_id JOIN recipe t3 ON t2.recipe_code = t3.recipe_code JOIN main_category t4 ON t3.category_id = t4.category_id WHERE t1.branch_code = #{branchCode} AND t1.order_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY
t3.name, t4.name
DATE_FORMAT(t1.order_date, '%Y-%m-%d'), meta
name
HOUR(t1.created_at)
ORDER BY value ${order} LIMIT 10
